values.note: Some sites reservable on recreation.gov, the rest first-come, first-served (the catalog lists 14 standard sites as not reservable).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('Visit Recreation.gov or call (877) 444-6777 ... First-come, first-served sites also available'; 'Stay limit is 14 days') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273780 ('First-come, first-served sites available and sites available for advanced reservation'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use April - Oct'. In 2026 recreation.gov sells nights through Oct 30 and shows every site closed Oct 31.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('Seasons of Use April - Oct') + recreation.gov availability for October 2026, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Single site $28, double site $56; the electric sites are $35 on recreation.gov.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('Single Site: $28 per night Double Site: $56 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273780/rates (2027 season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28, STANDARD ELECTRIC 35), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('37 primitive campsites with 3 campsites with electric hookups') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 273780 (RIDB, fetched 2026-10-20) (reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC site 025 'Electricity Hookup 30'; the water/sewer attributes are only on management sites 013 and 001), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('Potable water is available'; 'hot showers and restrooms with flush toilets'; 'a small supply store where campers can purchase firewood, ice'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/black-mountain-campground ('Overnight Use: 50% discount for single site camping with any of these passes: Interagency Senior, Interagency Access, Golden Age, or Golden Access'), read 2026-10-21

summary: FS page (run by concessionaire FIND Outdoors) + recreation.gov confirm $28 (electric $35), 37 sites with 3 electric (30A), showers/flush toilets/water/store, reservable plus FCFS sites, 14-day limit, April-Oct season, Senior/Access 50%; open now (the Oct 9-13, 2026 Hurricane Isaias closure of the campground and FSR 472 has ended). Catalog gives driveway lengths (15-50 ft) but no max vehicle length.
flags: Phone missing: the campground's number on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov is 828-675-5616 (FIND Outdoors, the concessionaire named on the FS page); Appalachian Ranger District 828-689-9694.
